dedupeText: urban gritty hip hop album cover urban grit cityscape fire hip hop aesthetic black and gold typography low key lighting 90s rap cover subject in the foreground partially obscured by shadow burning skyscrapers in the background providing the primary light source large ornate display text at the top and staggered serif text at the bottom high contrast between deep blacks and fiery oranges yellows combine a dark shadowed portrait with a catastrophic urban background fire smoke and layer with high contrast textured display typography for a gritty 90s street aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, gritty urban scene featuring a central figure in a beanie, set against a dark cityscape illuminated by intense orange fire and smoke. The composition uses a dark, moody palette with vibrant fire accents and stylized, textured typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in the foreground partially obscured by shadow
Burning skyscrapers in the background providing the primary light source
Large, ornate display text at the top and staggered serif text at the bottom
High contrast between deep blacks and fiery oranges/yellows
coreInvariants: Low-key lighting on the subject's face
Grainy, film-like texture across the entire image
Fiery glow reflecting on the subject's skin and clothing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, medium close-up, slightly off-center to the right, occupying about 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large, stylized title at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top title, down to the subject's face, then left to the burning buildings, and finally down to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of deep black negative space in the lower right and upper corners to emphasize the fire and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark navy for shadows and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange and yellow for fire, smoke, and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold and red for the typographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast; saturation is concentrated in the fire and text, while the rest of the image is desaturated and dark.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm tones for highlights

letterConstructionRules: Top text uses a jagged, hand-drawn gothic style with internal texture
Bottom text uses a heavy slab serif with irregular baseline alignment
Distressed edges and inner glows on all characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Elongated descenders on the top text
Underlined emphasis on specific words in the bottom block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of ornate, aggressive gothic display with stable, grounded slab serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive gothic feel of the top text.
Matches the slab serif structure of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty, dark urban scene at night. A man in a dark beanie and jacket is in the foreground, his face partially in shadow. In the background, silhouettes of skyscrapers are engulfed in intense orange and yellow flames and smoke. Use a grainy, 90s film aesthetic with high contrast.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, stylized gothic title in gold with red outlines at the top. Add a four-line staggered slab serif subtitle in cream and red in the bottom left quadrant, with one word underlined.

verificationChecks: Is the fire the primary light source?
Does the top text have a jagged, textured feel?
Is the overall image grainy and high-contrast?

adjustableVariables: Degree of shadow on the subject's face
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the fire looks integrated into the scene
Check that the text is legible but distressed
Verify the 90s hip-hop aesthetic is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dark, shadowed portrait with a catastrophic urban background (fire/smoke) and layer with high-contrast, textured display typography for a gritty 90s street aesthetic.
